“你的问题太多了。”梦妖裂开大嘴，笑道：“我还没有品尝过上清宗弟子是什么味道的，让我尝尝看！”
说罢，直接化作一股妖风和叶紫樱大战到一起。
叶紫樱也是将自身的真气给发挥到极致，和那梦妖对战。
但是叶紫樱不过是七品的境界，而这梦妖的修为竟然已经达到了八品，凭借玉照功，叶紫樱勉强能和梦妖抗衡，可是随着时间过去，叶紫樱的体力有些跟不上了，就连真气都有些枯竭了。
渐渐的，叶紫樱就落入到了下风。
“爹，你快走！”
叶紫樱知道自己怕是拦不住这梦妖，于是想让叶青北赶紧离开。
叶青北此刻脸色极为紧张。
但是让他把女儿给丢下来离开这里，他根本做不到。
“砰！”
梦妖一道掌力轰出，此刻叶紫樱已经无法阻挡，被这一掌给逼退，忍不住吐出一口血。
“上清宗弟子，不过如此。”梦妖笑着说。
然后就奔着叶青北走去。
“爹！”
叶紫樱此刻有些后悔自己托大了，本来离开之前，宗门的师兄还问要不要帮忙，结果自己觉得能在白云城中横行的肯定只是小妖罢了。
自己轻轻松松就能解决，甚至连灵宝都没带。
结果怎么都没想到，来白云城的梦妖竟然足足有八品。
并且是为了对付父亲而来。
“不许动我爹！”就在这个时候，一声沉闷的声响传来，只见竟然是叶云站在梦妖的身后，手中握着一根长棍狠狠的敲在了梦妖的头顶上。

只不过就凭借叶云的实力，这还不够给梦妖挠痒痒的呢。
“小子。”
“你还真的很勇啊。”
梦妖回眸咧嘴一笑，然后仅仅是抬起枯瘦的手掌，就将叶云给打飞到屋里。
叶云当场吐血，摔到地上，摔了个七荤八素。
“云儿！”叶青北大声惊呼着。
“罢了。”梦妖回头看向叶青北说道：“本来我是想以入梦的形式去寻找一些东西的，但是现在我也懒得自己去找了，你告诉我，九皇子去哪里了？”
听到这话，叶青北神色一变，然后说道：“九皇子的行踪我怎么可能会知道。”
“是么。”梦妖点点头，然后转身走向屋内：“你若是不知道的话，我就杀了你儿子给你提提醒！”
说完，梦妖将在地上痛苦挣扎的叶云给抓了起来，一只手掐着叶云的脖子，叶云的表情十分痛苦，而梦妖的手掌仿佛下一秒就能将叶云给捏死。
“住手！”
叶青北怒吼着，他的青筋暴起，心中也在做着痛苦的挣扎。
“我给你三个呼吸的时间……”梦妖的手掌此刻缓缓捏紧。
叶紫樱看着弟弟被梦妖捏在手中，也是没有任何办法。
然而就在这个时候，梦妖却是听到此刻涨红了脸的叶云仿佛在说着什么。
“你说什么？”梦妖好奇的将脸凑过去。
“我说……你……去……死！”叶云拼了命的喊出这几个字，然后猛然抬起手，不知何时，在叶云的手中出现了一道符篆！
趁着梦妖完全没有防备，叶云手中的符篆直接就贴到了梦妖的额头上。
刚刚叶云倒地的时候，那符篆就在他的手边，虽然他相信叶紫樱说的，这东西很可能就是骗人的，可到了这个时候，叶云还是宁愿赌一把。
“嗡！”

"You have too many questions." Meng Yao opened his mouth and smiled: "I haven't tasted what a Shangqing Sect disciple tastes like, let me have a taste!"
After that, it turned into a demonic wind and fought with Ye Ziying.
Ye Ziying also used her true energy to the extreme to fight against the dream monster.
But Ye Ziying is only at the seventh level, and the dream demon's cultivation has actually reached the eighth level. With the Jade Zhao Gong, Ye Ziying can barely compete with the dream demon, but as time goes by, Ye Ziying's physical strength can't keep up, and even her true energy is somewhat exhausted.
Gradually, Ye Ziying fell into a disadvantage.
"Dad, leave quickly!"
Ye Ziying knew that she might not be able to stop the dream monster, so she wanted Ye Qingbei to leave quickly.
Ye Qingbei looked extremely nervous at this moment.
But if he was asked to leave his daughter behind, he simply couldn't do it.
"Bang!"
The dream demon blasted out with a palm force. Ye Ziying was unable to stop it at this moment. She was forced back by this palm and couldn't help spitting out a mouthful of blood.
"A disciple of the Shangqing Sect, that's all." Meng Yao said with a smile.
Then he ran towards Ye Qingbei.
"Dad!"
At this moment, Ye Ziying regretted that she had trusted her. Before she left, the sect's senior brothers had asked if they wanted to help, but in the end, she felt that those who could run rampant in Baiyun City must be just little monsters.
I can solve it easily by myself, without even bringing the spirit treasure.
As a result, I never expected that the dream monsters who came to Baiyun City were actually at the eighth level.
And he came to deal with his father.
"Don't touch my dad!" At this moment, a dull sound came, and it was Ye Yun standing behind the dream demon, holding a long stick in his hand and hitting the dream demon hard on the head.
But relying on Ye Yun's strength, this is not enough to scratch the dream demon's itch.
"Boy."
"You are really brave."
The dream demon looked back and grinned, then just raised his skinny palm and knocked Ye Yun away into the house.
Ye Yun vomited blood on the spot and fell to the ground, smashing his body.
"Yun'er!" Ye Qingbei exclaimed loudly.
"That's all." The dream demon turned back to Ye Qingbei and said, "Originally I wanted to find something in my dream, but now I'm too lazy to look for it myself. Tell me, where did the Ninth Prince go?"
Hearing this, Ye Qingbei's expression changed, and then he said: "How could I possibly know the whereabouts of the Ninth Prince?"
"Really." Dream Demon nodded, then turned and walked towards the house: "If you don't know, I will kill your son to remind you!"
After saying that, Meng Yao grabbed Ye Yun who was struggling painfully on the ground, and pinched Ye Yun's neck with one hand. Ye Yun's expression was very painful, and Meng Yao's palm seemed to be able to crush Ye Yun to death in the next second.
"Stop!"
Ye Qingbei roared angrily, his veins popped out, and he was also struggling painfully in his heart.
"I'll give you three breaths..." The dream demon's palms slowly clenched at this moment.
Ye Ziying watched her younger brother being pinched by the dream demon, but there was nothing she could do about it.
However, at this moment, Meng Yao heard what Ye Yun, who was blushing at the moment, seemed to be saying.
"What did you say?" Dream Demon asked his face curiously.
"I said...you...go...die!" Ye Yun yelled out these words with all his strength, and then suddenly raised his hand. At some point, a talisman appeared in Ye Yun's hand!
Taking advantage of Meng Yao's complete defenselessness, the talisman in Ye Yun's hand was directly attached to Meng Yao's forehead.
When Ye Yun fell to the ground just now, the talisman was in his hand. Although he believed what Ye Ziying said that this thing was probably a lie, at this time, Ye Yun still preferred to take a gamble.
"Buzz!"
